premise.claim: Stateful RoleInstanceSet rolling updates and scale-down can delete a RoleInstance without waiting for its existing spec.lifecycle.preDelete hook; a consumer cannot finish draining the instance before its Pods are removed.
premise.evidence: The PR's own new test (lifecycle_test.go) grafted unchanged onto base fd160cc FAILS: both rolling-update and scale-down delete the hooked instance on the first reconcile ('deleted = [hook-rolling-update-0], want []'). See README.
